reply.analysis: Proven: bracket [20, 20]. Lower bound 20 is an independent set (check passed); upper bound 20 is a linear code over F_17 with c = 16 whose length meets the lower bound. Code fit, factorization and decoding checks all passed. Wall time was 30.957 s, of which 30.918 s was LLM time and compute was 0.039 s. Baselines: CP-SAT alpha also proved 20 in 0.60 s (faster in wall time). CP-SAT cover reached only 21, unproven after 120.4 s. Fractional cover gave 21 in 26.5 s. F2 min-rank SAT proved only 19 as a lower bound. The Kushagra agent also reached [20, 20] with field 17 in 0.030 s, faster than this agent. Nothing suspicious: all numbers agree.
